login.title: Sign in with Discord and set up each server in its own dashboard.
login.description: Access is granted per server: if the Bot is installed and you have permission, the dashboard is ready for you to set up modules, channels and automations.
login.footnote: You sign in with your Discord account. No server opens without manage permission.

pending.title: Awaiting approval
pending.introSuffix: hasn't been approved yet. We're in closed beta and each server is approved manually. Until then, the dashboard stays locked and the Bot doesn't respond to commands in this server. It's still there, just paused.
pending.meaning: the Bot is already in the server, but the dashboard, commands and webhooks stay locked until approval.
